data.name: Claudius
data.gender_notes: Claudius is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'claudus' meaning lame or famous. The name Claudius was borne by several Roman emperors, including the one known for his 'Claudian Wars'. In Christianity, St. Claudius of Turin is a revered figure. The name Claudius carries the meaning “Famous, glory, fame” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Claudius usually hope their child will grow to embody famous, glory, fame and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing renown and glory.
data.etymology: Claudius belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Famous, glory, fame.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Claudius total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Claudius holds an illustrious history in the Roman Empire with several emperors carrying this name. Known for their military conquests and architectural feats, these emperors left an indelible mark on Roman and later European history. The name continues to evoke notions of power, glory, and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: Saint Claudius of Turin, a third-century bishop, is a knights-errant against demons. According to legend, he battled demons in disguise and converted them to Christianity. His courage and faith demonstrate how the Christian values of courage, strength, and perseverance can be employed against spiritual adversities. The name Claudius thus carries a spiritual significance of spiritual warfare and victory over adversity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Claudius carries profound spiritual symbolism as it is rooted in Biblical tradition.
